desc: Introducing the LINK(TM) for CZ Scorpion. Originally manufactured by Side Project, LLC in 2016, Reptilia is bringing the design back to life as part of a merger with the Side Project team. The LINK allows seamless attachment of the Magpul Zhukov folding stock to any CZ Scorpion EVO3 S1 firearm (Magpul Zhukov stock included). Machined from aircraft grade aluminum with Milspec Type III hard anodized finish, the LINK is ideal for any shooter seeking the most functional and robust stock available for the Scorpion platform. Like all Reptilia products, the LINK is 100% made in the USA.
